summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__, set and cleared in run()'s run_app wrapper via try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass on the venv Python 3.9 with PYTHONPATH=src. Full non-snapshot suite: 615 passed, 68 failed, all from missing async test plugin (async def not supported); tests/cli and tests/devtools excluded because aiohttp is not installed. Nothing committed. Known limitation: a call in flight during shutdown can block because the loop stops before running it; the spec forbids watching loop state, so it was left as is.
